scope: First two-pair persistent Wan-Animate-2 full-length launch
summary: The first four-GPU launch was stopped after both upstream workers inherited TCP port 12345 and the second pair failed torch.distributed initialization with EADDRINUSE.
evidence: Batch 01 inference.log records DistNetworkError EADDRINUSE on port 12345.
The exact process group for this experiment was terminated after resolving every PID; GPUs 1, 4, 5, and 6 returned to 3 MiB used.
lessons: Every concurrent model worker needs a distinct recorded distributed rendezvous port, and all ports and GPU pairs must pass one transactional launch preflight before any worker starts.
limitations: Metadata retains status=running because the process group was externally terminated to avoid wasting GPU time; this ledger record is the correcting conclusion.
next_actions: Assign and availability-check ports 29500 and 29501, then rerun in a new experiment directory.
